blocks.text: Japan’s Masamichi Yabuki defended his IBF flyweight world title for the third time by beating Miel Fajardo of the Philippines by unanimous decision on Thursday. Yabuki was in control from the opening bell at Ebara Wave Arena Ota in Tokyo, improving his record to 21 wins, including 18 by knockout, and four losses.
